learning_outcomes.text: Describe, identify and evaluate the foundations of Cellular Systems
Identify and evaluate the effects of Mobile Radio Propagation
Identify, compare and evaluate the main Multiple-Access Systems for mobile users
Describe and identify and evaluate the Mobile Communications Systems of 3rd, 4th and 5th Generation
Describe and identify and evaluate the Wireless Information Networks based on IEEE.802.11 standard

syllabus_topics: Foundations of the planning of Cellular Systems
Introduction to the cellular system concept.
Average path loss for macro, micro and pico cells.
Using HSDPA to provide the MBMS Service
Introduction to WLAN networks. Introduction to IEEE802.11a, b, g, n, ac, and ax networks.
5G Private Networks including Private Mobile Radio

assessment_methods.method: Group work on eMBMS in 5GNR with individual evaluation

assessment_rules: For Semester Evaluation, attendance of at least 50% of classes is required. The grade is composed of 5% active class participation, 30% group work with individual evaluation, and 65% a final test. A minimum grade of 7.5 is required in the final test for this modality. For Evaluation by exam, the grade is 100% based on the 1st exam, 2nd exam, or a special exam, with a minimum grade of 9.5 required.
